description: Prudential plc acquires Shield Assurance; renamed Prudential Life Assurance Kenya (before the data window)
Metropolitan Life Kenya and Cannon Assurance consolidate their life licences into Metropolitan Cannon Life Assurance
Madison Insurance Company Kenya demerges; life business continues as Madison Life Assurance Kenya (exact date to confirm from IRA name change)
Barclays Life Assurance Kenya renamed Absa Life Assurance Kenya
UAP Life acquires OMLAC; OMLAC becomes a closed fund and all new life business is written in UAP Life (approved 2021; exact quarter to confirm in IRA data)
ICEA Life Assurance renamed ICEA LION Life Assurance
Equity Life Assurance (Kenya) licensed by IRA
UAP Life Assurance renamed Old Mutual Life Assurance Kenya (OMLAK)
Momentum Metropolitan sells its 66.29% stake to local shareholders; Metropolitan Cannon Life later renamed Cannon Life Assurance (K)
OMLAC long-term business transferred to OMLAK (regulatory approval reported by Zawya; set effective_date to the first quarter OMLAC stops reporting)
Tamini Insurance (Djibouti) acquires a majority stake in Takaful Insurance of Africa
Sanlam Life Insurance renamed Sanlam Allianz Life Insurance (Kenya); parent plans to take the life business into the listed company
Absa sells its stake to First Assurance Investments; Absa Life Assurance Kenya to be renamed First Assurance Life
